sloka: तं गृहीत्वा महास्कन्धं सो ऽश्वकर्णं महाद्युतिः ।प्रहस्य परया प्रीत्या भ्रामयामास संयुगे ।। ६.५६.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ gṛhītvā mahāskandhaṁ so 'śvakarṇaṁ mahādyutiḥ ।prahasya parayā prītyā bhrāmayāmāsa saṁyuge ।। 6.56.21 ।।।।

translations.english: He (Hanuman) endowed with great splendour, seizing a huge trunk of Aswakarana tree with great delight, whirled it round on the ground laughing.
